title: Lighthouse Pattern Candidate Disposition
description: One local operator decision about one EXACT candidate version (LHP-INTEL-03B, ADR-0021). A disposition is NOT a finding, NOT a Gateway approval, and NOT authorization to publish or execute — and it has no field in which any of those could be written. 'accepted_for_followup' means 'this deserves more investigation', never 'this claim is true'. Records are append-only and bind to the candidate's artifact_digest, so a decision always names the exact evidence it was made against; when the evidence changes, the detector produces a NEW candidate version which may receive its own decision. Exactly ONE disposition per candidate version in v1, enforced by a UNIQUE index in the database rather than by a service-side check alone. Reopening and supersession are deliberately not implemented. This document is a human-facing reference mirror; the AUTHORITATIVE enforcer is modules/pattern_candidate.py (PatternDisposition.validate(), which RECOMPUTES artifact_digest).

disposition_id.description: The artifact digest, typed. Derived, never supplied.

candidate_id.description: The exact candidate VERSION this decision is about.

candidate_artifact_digest.description: The candidate's content digest. Validation requires candidate_id == 'pc_' + this, so a decision cannot drift onto a different version of the evidence.

created_at.description: UTC ISO-8601. DIGEST-EXCLUDED, like the candidate's.

operator_id.description: Who decided. Required and non-empty — but see operator_identity_authenticated.

decision.description: A closed vocabulary with no verdict in it. There is deliberately no 'approved', 'verified', 'finding', 'published' or 'rejected_as_false'.

reason.description: Why, in the operator's own words. Required and non-empty: a decision with no reason is not reviewable later.

operator_identity_authenticated.description: We do not claim an authentication that does not exist. A CLI flag is a label, not an identity — and pinning the denial is more honest than omitting the field.

artifact_digest.description: SHA-256 over canonical JSON of every field EXCEPT disposition_id, created_at and artifact_digest itself.
